paragraphs.notes: Continuation page: the whole body is one unbroken enumeration of substituent group names that begins on an earlier page and runs on past the last line (the page ends mid-word at "Cycloalkyl-", with no terminating punctuation). The patent carries no [00NN] paragraph markers, so marker is null. Transcription joins the printed lines into flowing text; where a line ended with a word-internal hyphen ("N-Alkyl-N-" / "heteroarylaminocarbonyloxy") the halves are joined without a space, and the trailing "Cycloalkyl-" of the last line is left as printed. Standalone hyphens in "Mono- oder" are as printed. The German is limited to the connectives "gegebenenfalls substituiertes" (optionally substituted), "Mono-", "oder" and the German spellings of the group names; en therefore differs from zh mainly in those connectives, in lower-casing the group names, and in rendering German "Alkinyl" as English "alkynyl". Printed as-is and not corrected: the enumeration jumps from the ...aminocarbonyl series straight to "gegebenenfalls substituiertes Mono- oder Diheteroarylaminocarbonyloxy", i.e. the corresponding Dialkyl- and Diaryl-aminocarbonyloxy members are absent from the printed list; and "N-Alkyl-N-arylaminocarbonyl-amino" is hyphenated where the parallel entries are not.
